subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or is sibling Codex source plus focused OpenClaw helper coverage enough for this warning-path fix?
rationale: The code direction is maintainable, but current OpenClaw projection maps native commandExecution items to `bash`, so only maintainers can decide whether the remaining producer-path uncertainty is acceptable.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording that demonstrates both suppressed read-only `exec_command` failures and visible mutating failures after the refreshed patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the Codex source contract plus focused tests and merge after resolving conflicts and CI, while owning the remaining live-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause or close the stale branch
options.body: If no live or producer-path proof is forthcoming, close this PR and leave the canonical issue open for a fresh proven fix.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording that demonstrates both suppressed read-only `exec_command` failures and visible mutating failures after the refreshed patch.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle already routed related duplicate PRs around this exact fix shape and is the clearest reviewer for the proof-sufficiency choice.
